column1: Amazon Sustainability Policy Positions
Increasing the deployment of renewable energy resources is valuable for the planet, good
for business and important for our customers. As part of our sustainability efforts, Amazon
advocates in support of public policy that advances access to and the expansion of clean energy.
We will continue to promote policies that support renewable energy to power our operations.
Since 2016, we have taken the following actions in support of promoting clean energy and
addressing climate change.
